name: last.fm
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But buttons must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every button text or an aria-label, so a screen reader can announce it.
summary: www.last.fm scores 62 out of 100 (D). 5 checks fail now, 35 are at risk, and 28 pass. Fix first: buttons must have discernible text.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /search, /pro, for example .js-switch-device. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 80 elements on /, /search, /pro, for example .footer-top-col:nth-child(1) > .footer-heading and .footer-top-col:nth-child(2) > .footer-heading. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 3 cookies are sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: lfmanon, not_first_visit, _fs_ch_st_FSBmUei20MqUiJb9. Without HttpOnly: csrftoken. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /search, /pro and 16 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (2 requests), Criteo (2 requests), Google Analytics (1 request), and cookies __cf_bm on snigelweb.com, _ga_JSW4CH2WD0, _ga, __Secure-YNID on youtube.com, YSC…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 27 elements on /, /search, /pro, for example a[href$="about"] and a[href$="contact"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Some pages are closed to AI answer crawlers
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot cannot read 2 pages, ChatGPT-User cannot read 2 pages, Claude-SearchBot cannot read 2 pages, Claude-User cannot read 2 pages.
fix.fix: Check that the closed paths are meant to stay out of AI answers.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 244 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
